response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and software development skills with experience in diverse domains, but his background lacks direct alignment with the core requirements of a Principal Performance Architect role, particularly in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator optimization, and hardware-software co-design. His experience with performance optimization and low-latency systems is relevant but not at the depth required for this role.
strengths: Extensive experience with low-latency and high-performance systems (e.g., DLang at Sociomantic, real-time data processing).
Strong full-stack development background with exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling (re:cinq).
Proven leadership in open-source projects (e.g., GISCollective) and community contributions (workshops, talks).
concerns: No explicit experience with SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator optimization, or hardware-software co-design.
Lacks advanced degrees (PhD/Master's) or equivalent professional experience in hardware performance architecture.
Background is primarily software-focused, with limited evidence of deep hardware or GPU architecture expertise.
